title: claude-broker base task envelope
description: A unit of work dispatched into a worker inbox (or the orchestrator inbox in some namespaces). Base holds only fields common to every namespace; per-namespace rules (task_id format, required body, brand, ...) are manifest extensions.

task_id.description: Unique task key. Namespaces constrain the format via a manifest extension (e.g. cb-YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>).

to.description: Addressee: a worker name, 'orchestrator', or '*' for broadcast.

subject.description: Headline, readable in the summary projection.

body.description: Free-form payload. Namespaces may constrain it via manifest extensions.

refs.description: Message ids, task_ids, commit shas, URLs.

background.description: Deeper context: prior decisions, related tasks, what failed before.

depends_on.description: '<task_id>:<worker>' entries that must have a type:result on the status channel first.

write.description: Only files the worker may modify.

checks.description: Executable checks the worker runs before posting a result.

required_checks.description: Legacy check labels; superseded by checks.

acceptance_criteria.description: Deliverables the worker confirms before posting a result.

scope.description: small <30 min, medium 30-90 min, large >90 min (expect rotation).

plan_required.description: true = the worker posts a type:plan on the status channel and waits for a plan-decision before changing files.
